en.headline: Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to Wan Chai harbourfront this weekend
en.dek: Ne-Yo, MEOVV and local artists headline three nights of performances with large installations from 30 October.
body: The Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to the Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space from 30 October to 1 November.

Organisers said the event will feature R&B singer Ne-Yo, K-pop group MEOVV, and members of local band Mirror, along with other performers across the three nights. The site includes large-scale installations such as a nine-metre Colossal Titan figure and a haunted maze designed with streetwear brand CLOT.
Tickets for main-stage access are available through official channels, with carnival-zone entry offered at a lower price. The event runs during daytime and evening hours over the long weekend.
The carnival is one of several Halloween-themed programmes taking place across Hong Kong districts this month, alongside street events and theme-park activities.

zh.headline: 灣仔海濱「Spooky Halloween」音樂嘉年華本周末回歸
zh.dek: Ne-Yo、MEOVV及本地藝人將於10月30日起三晚演出，現場設大型裝置。
body: Spooky Halloween音樂嘉年華將於10月30日至11月1日在灣仔海濱活動空間舉行。
主辦單位表示，三晚演出包括R&B歌手Ne-Yo、韓國女團MEOVV及本地組合Mirror成員等。場地設有九米高「超大型巨人」裝置，以及與CLOT合作的鬼魅迷宮。
主舞台門票可經官方渠道購買，嘉年華區入場則設較低票價。活動於長周末日間及晚間進行。
這是本月香港多個地區萬聖節相關節目之一，與街頭活動及主題公園項目同期舉行。
